name: @etzhayyim/crowdfunding-kotoba
description: kotoba reference implementation of crowdfunding (on-chain campaigns + pledges) using @etzhayyim/sdk. Tier-2 function-split per ADR-2606011400 (on-chain-only): pledges settle on-chain USDC via TitheRouter (10% Public Fund). No Stripe, no RW. Substrate posture per ADR-2605172000.
